title: Evaluate Division
summary: Given an array of equations in the form of pairs [Ai, Bi] and their corresponding values, and a set of queries in the form [Cj, Dj], calculate the value of each query by dividing the variables Cj by Dj.
statement: Given an array of equations in the form of pairs [Ai, Bi] and their corresponding values, and a set of queries in the form [Cj, Dj], calculate the value of each query by dividing the variables Cj by Dj. If a division cannot be determined, return -1.0. Variables not present in the equations are undefined, and thus their division cannot be calculated.
constraints: Equation values are positive and mutually consistent.
Unknown variables produce -1.0, including unknown divided by itself.
hints: Treat each equation a/b=v as weighted edges a→b with v and b→a with 1/v.
For each query, search from numerator to denominator while multiplying edge weights.
Reject immediately when either endpoint is unknown; otherwise BFS with a visited set.
A path product cancels intermediate variables and equals the requested quotient.
editorial: A path product cancels intermediate variables and equals the requested quotient.

tests.explanation: The reverse edge has weight one quarter, and a known variable divided by itself is one.
